prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit and refine the attached two-phone BE workout mockup into ONE approved compact training experience shown in two states, not competing alternatives. Professional exceptionally polished mobile product design, large readable Spanish typography, matte midnight navy background #031725, panels #082B40, thin blue edges, cyan #12CBE9 accents, off-white text. Remove glossy rectangular lighting patches completely. Landscape presentation with two large flat front-on phone screens, generous readable design, no perspective, no dense annotation. Title outside phones: "BE · Entrenamiento por serie". Small subtitle "Propuesta visual · Datos sintéticos". Left caption "REGISTRAR UNA SERIE". Right caption "DESCANSO EN CURSO". BE wordmark text only; do not invent a new logo symbol. Preserve restrained reference aesthetic.
Both phone screens: compact top bar back arrow, BE, Ver rutina. Then row "Piernas A" and stopwatch "Sesión 05:24" (left session 04:12). One SINGLE current exercise only, not other exercise cards. Exercise hero 120dp tall with a larger clear athletic adult doing a goblet squat illustration left, right title "Sentadilla goblet", "Ejercicio 1 de 3", and "Ver técnica ›". Image is tappable. Show no other exercises on this page.
Left screen: heading "Serie 1 de 3". Table columns "Serie", "kg", "Rep.", "RIR ⓘ". Three clear rows with input boxes. Every input empty with muted slate-gray readable placeholder planned targets: row 1 "16", "12–16", "3"; row 2 "18", "10–12", "2"; row 3 "20", "8–10", "1". Row1 active cyan outer line. Grey placeholder appearance DIFFERENT from entered actual values. Below table small note "En gris: lo planificado". Then persistent quiet panel "Plan de la serie 1" and "16 kg · 12–16 rep. · RIR 3" and "Descanso recomendado: 1:30". Compact RIR help: "RIR (opcional)" and "Cuántas repeticiones más creés que podrías hacer con buena técnica." Secondary link with stopwatch icon "Cronometrar serie". Main button "Registrar serie 1" in visibly disabled style because there are no entered actual data, empty targets are not data. Foot text "Completá lo que hiciste." Bottom compact rest card "Descanso" "Recomendado tras esta serie: 1:30" with outlined button "Iniciar descanso".
Right screen same exercise same table dimensions: heading "Serie 1 guardada". Row1 entered values bold white "16", "14", "3", plus small cyan check by row number. Row2 and row3 still gray placeholders as left. Small note "Guardado en esta sesión". Below table quiet persistent panel "Plan de la serie 1" and "16 kg · 12–16 rep. · RIR 3". Then LARGE prominent rest timer panel: label "Descanso · Serie 1", timer "01:02", line "Recomendado: 01:30", clear cyan fullwidth button "Finalizar descanso". Then unobtrusive "Al terminar, seguís con la serie 2". Footer text "Pausar sesión". Timer counts up, no plus15 or skip-rest arrows, no previous workout comparisons, no +/-15 control, no automatic stop. No calendar no charts no unrelated exercises, no bottom tab bar in focused session, all content within screen safe area. Each phone must be legible and beautifully aligned. This is a design concept not a running application.
referenceNote: Se usó la anterior exploración de registrar serie como referencia de estilo. La nueva imagen la sustituye.
